selected_baseline.label: retained_release_go_baseline
selection_rationale: The retained release authority files `release-check-summary.md` and `.workflow/evidence/release/release-readiness-artifact.json` both end in `Decision: GO` for this exact SHA and version.
The 2026-04-18 upstream analysis explicitly states that the formal GO proof is bound to `4d63e03 / 9.0.8`, not to the current 2026-04-18 worktree state.
Choosing the retained baseline keeps later smoke, shipment-mode, platform-scope, and bundle tasks traceable to one already validated build identity without refreshing proof in this issue.

rejected_candidates.label: current_dirty_workspace_head
rejection_rationale: The current repository HEAD has no retained release-readiness artifact or release summary bound to `802c7771720adfafc6e0ba682835273d2c6bb082`.
The repository remained dirty at decision time (`58` modified, `124` untracked via `git status --short` on 2026-04-18), so it is not a frozen customer-delivery baseline.
Per the validated solution constraints, selecting a newer SHA would require explicit operator or business confirmation and refreshed release proof, which is intentionally deferred to later work.

superseded_authority_claims.note: Contains an older handoff note that treated the current worktree plus regenerated packaging proof as authoritative. This is treated as superseded for customer delivery because no stronger retained release artifact re-binds authority to `802c777`.
The 2026-04-13 handoff session recorded a GO-with-note state for a then-current worktree, but the 2026-04-18 analysis narrowed retained delivery authority back to the exact 2026-04-17 GO proof set.
